### A Secure Inheritance
Author: Mark Ross
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/secure-inheritance
Passage: Numbers 27:4
Points:
- Zelophehad's daughters faced the loss of their family line and inheritance under standard customs.
- The daughters brought their concern before Moses, who presented the case directly to the Lord.
- God affirmed their request, ruling that they must receive their father's property.
- The narrative foreshadows the eternal inheritance secured for all believers through Jesus Christ.
- While believers still experience earthly death, no child of God will lose their promised inheritance.

### Let the Lord Decide
Author: Daily Disciples Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-devotional-mar-3-2009-11600203.html
Passage: Numbers 27:4-7
Points:
- Earthly systems and majority-oriented customs do not always treat people fairly.
- The daughters of Zelophehad recognized an injustice and boldly asked for intervention.
- God heard their appeal and affirmed that their request was entirely right.
- Believers are invited to take every perceived unfairness and life struggle directly to the Lord.
- Rather than merely accepting worldly standards, believers can trust God to determine what is just.
